name: Bauhaus
pitch: A bold, opinionated talk about first principles, where every idea is reduced to a circle, a triangle, or a square.

illustration.medium: flat vector, Bauhaus school poster illustration on warm cream
illustration.line: 4px flat strokes where used, mostly line-free solid shapes
illustration.shapes: primary geometric forms only: circles, triangles, and squares, composed in bold overlapping arrangements
illustration.palette_use: cream background dominant, one primary red, one primary blue, and one mustard yellow used as the full accent set, each as a solid shape
illustration.avoid: gradients, photorealism, hand-drawn wobble, decorative ornament, any shape beyond circle/triangle/square
